cards.title: Copy ZOMBIE 1 clearance
cards.leadIn: In the run-ups, after the overspeed governor and before-takeoff checklists, but before calling for taxi:

exchange.speaker: Pilot
exchange.text: Navy Corpus Clearance, <callsign>, ZOMBIE 1 on request, ready to copy.

exchange.speaker: Clearance
exchange.text: <callsign>, Navy Corpus Clearance, for VFR flight following, squawk <code>.
